# eSignatures.io

eSignatures.io provides a platform for sending and signing mobile-friendly contracts over the web.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/esignatures-io/.

## Actions

- **Create Contract**: Create a new contract using a specified template and signer details.
- **Create Signer**: Create a new signer profile.
- **Create Template**: Create a new template.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a specific template by its id.
- **Get Template** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific template by its id.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all templates.
- **Withdraw Contract**: Withdraw a contract by its id.
